DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Their Pillar of Frost is active and aligned with their primary damage cooldown window.
  • Both Pillar of Frost and Empower Rune Weapon are available to synergize with their burst phase.
  • They are executing a Breath of Sindragosa build and have sufficient resources to sustain the channel.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • The Deathknight has Summon Gargoyle active with ≤22 seconds remaining, and they’re in single-target or add-priority scenarios.
  • The Deathknight is using Army of the Dead and has either their Abomination (with ≤18 seconds left) or Army Ghouls (with ≤18 seconds left) active.
  • The Deathknight has Dark Transformation active, especially if they aren’t using Gargoyle or Army of the Dead talents.
  • Summon Gargoyle is unavailable (cooldown +10 seconds exceeds Power Infusion duration) and the DK isn’t using Gargoyle.
  • There are ≥3 enemies with Dark Transformation active or Death and Decay active on the ground.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They activate Metamorphosis to amplify their burst damage window
  • The encounter is in its final 20 seconds to maximize last-phase damage output
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • The Druid is in their primary cooldown window (via Celestial Alignment) and does NOT have the Keeper of the Grove 4-piece tier set active.
  • The Druid has the Keeper of the Grove 4-piece tier set and is triggering their enhanced Celestial Alignment timing (during Keeper of the Grove empowerment).
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • Bloodlust, Heroism, or Time Warp is active on the raid.
  • The Feral Druid does not have the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Dragonrage is active, and any of these are true: their Shattering Star is on cooldown, the target is affected by Shattering Star's debuff, or there are 2+ enemies in combat.
  • The encounter will end in under 35 seconds, regardless of other conditions.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • They activate Trueshot with more than 12 seconds remaining on its duration, aligning with their burst window.
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds, ensuring full utilization before combat ends.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active with more than 7 seconds remaining and Power Infusion isn’t already active.
  • The Hunter isn’t using Coordinated Assault and has activated Spearhead (its cooldown is ongoing).
  • The Hunter hasn’t selected either Coordinated Assault or Spearhead as talents.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They have just cast Arcane Surge as their previous global cooldown (GCD) ability.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • They do not already have Power Infusion active
  • Either their Combustion buff has more than 6 seconds remaining or the fight will end in under 25 seconds
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • their Power Infusion buff is not currently active on them.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • The Monk's Xuen the White Tiger is active.
  • Either Bloodlust is not active, or Bloodlust is active but Strike of the Windlord is still on cooldown.
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • the Paladin has Avenging Wrath active,
  • the Paladin has Crusade active (if using that talent),
  • or the Paladin's Execution Sentence debuff is active on the target.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • the Shadow Priest is in Voidform and Power Infusion is not already active.
  • they activate Dark Ascension and Power Infusion is not already active.
  • their The War Within Season 2 4-piece set bonus is active and Power Infusion is not already active.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Deathmark is currently active on the target, as this amplifies their strongest cooldown window.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • The Rogue has Shadow Dance active, as this aligns with their burst window and maximizes cooldown synergy.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • They activate Ascendance to amplify their burst damage window, or
  • Their Ascendance cooldown has over 30 seconds remaining, allowing alignment with other major cooldowns outside its rotation.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • they have Deeply Rooted Elements selected and Ascendance has more than 7.5 seconds remaining.
  • they do not have Deeply Rooted Elements and have Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds active.
  • the fight is in the final 20 seconds of a 2-minute window (e.g., aligning with recurring burst phases).
  • all their major cooldowns will be unavailable for the next 2 minutes, requiring immediate usage.
  • they have none of the core cooldown talents (Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds) selected.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • They have Shadow’s Embrace active (maintained by their damage-over-time spells), maximizing haste’s value during their core damage window.
  • Their other major cooldowns (e.g., Summon Darkglare) are active, aligning with their burst damage phase.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Their upcoming Imp Despawn timing (for summoning a Demonic Tyrant) is within 6 GCDs + 1 cast time of activating, aligning the buff with their max burst phase.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • The warlock's Infernal is currently active.
  • The warlock does not have the Summon Infernal talent specced.
  • The fight will end before the warlock's next Summon Infernal cooldown (plus 30 seconds) but has enough time left to fully use Power Infusion.
  • The remaining fight duration is less than 15 seconds after the warlock's next Summon Infernal cooldown.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • Colossus Smash is active on the target and the fight will last at least 135 seconds.
  • They are in Execute Phase (target below 20% health) and Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has over 15 seconds remaining and the fight will last at least 135 more seconds.
  • The enemy is in Execute phase (below 20% health) and Avatar is active.
  • The fight will end within 25 seconds (final burst window).
